data.title: 鸣濑白羽 · 盛夏向日葵海与白色灯塔
data.description: 鸟白岛怒放的金黄向日葵花田尽头矗立着洁白灯塔。白羽伫立在花海中央回首凝望，银白发丝在微风中飞舞，宛如夏日梦境中的孤岛精灵。
data.location: vast blooming yellow sunflower meadow on coastal hill leading to a white lighthouse
data.action: standing among tall sunflowers, looking back over shoulder with a serene faint smile, silver hair shimmering in warm sunlight
data.lighting: 盛夏明媚艳阳与向日葵花海金光
data.promptProse: Shiroha stands amid a vibrant sea of blooming sunflowers below a white coastal lighthouse, looking back with a serene, gentle gaze.
data.animaCaption: Golden sunlight bathes the tall sunflowers as she turns with a faint, peaceful smile.
